messages:
alex: Heads-up — brainstorming how to surface SLO alerts in Console for 'signal fidelity' (high false-positive vs true-positive tradeoffs). Thinking: add a 'signal-fidelity' slider in the alert UI, and routing that treats low-fidelity alerts as noisy (digest) and high-fidelity as immediate pages. Thoughts?
maria: Love the idea. Can we call it 'alert_confidence' or 'alert-confidence'? 'signal_fidelity' sounds too implementation-y for PMs.
sam: Agree on naming. Also want to be mindful of per-tenant overrides + quota implications — digests still consume quota.
taylor: Important: routing by fidelity needs telemetry first. We don’t currently propagate a confidence score through the pipeline end-to-end.
alex: Yep. Proposal: during eval/eval-harness we emit a confidence score [0-100]. Console UI shows a mini-histogram + default thresholds: >=90 page, 50-89 notify (no pager), <50 digest. We can make thresholds configurable per-team.
jin: Operational concern: noisy tenants may always be low-confidence but still cause real outages. We should have an error-budget override: if error_budget_drop > X then page regardless of confidence.
sam: +1. Also need to consider rate-limiting interplay. Suggest an 'escalation webhook' route that bypasses batching when error-budget crossed.
ops-bot: Incident-demo: created sample event -> tenant=acme-inc, confidence=38, error_budget_drop=0.02, routed_to=digest (simulated) :white_check_mark:
maria: Can we add a console preview mode? DevEx wants to preview routing outcomes for a given alert set before enabling.
alex: Quick config sketch below (proto):
```
routing:
  - when: confidence >= 90
    action: page
  - when: confidence >= 50 and error_budget_drop > 0.01
    action: notify
  - when: confidence < 50
    action: digest
  - override: if error_budget_drop >= 0.05 -> page
```
taylor: UX note: show a "Why was I paged/digested?" modal that highlights which rule fired and the metric values that triggered it. Helps with trust.
sam: Implementation notes: we need new telemetry fields: confidence, error_budget_delta, tenant_quota_snapshot. Also update notify API to accept an 'escalation' boolean so downstream integrations can choose channel.
alex: Timeline: beta behind feature flag for internal teams in 2 sprints. We need a short RFC + console mock.
maria: I'll draft the RFC and put it up for review. @sam @taylor can you two review? Jin can add runbook/ops bits.
taylor: :rocket: happy to review UX and mock.
alex: @maria can you assign RFC and set due date for end of next week?
maria: On it — creating RFC PR now: https://git.redwood.ai/rfcs/123 (WIP).
sam: Also, add a dashboard widget: routed vs digested vs paged counts (per-tenant). This will help tune thresholds.
alex: Good call. I'll add a backlog ticket for the Console dashboard.
maria: OK, locking this thread while RFC is in flight. :lock:
